name: Amagase Nanao
source:
A beautiful girl that gives off a mature and charming atmosphere. She is the head of the dormitory and is a surrogate older sister to everyone. She gently watches over everyone with devotion, and sometimes she teases her friends and juniors to show her mischievous side.
Despite this, she has a strong will, and is resolute in the face of hardship. She is considered the scariest person in the dorm when she is angry.
